It's merely a general purpose suffix. Faggot is used as a slur, albeit it barely relates to homosexuality - that is technically what it means, but honestly that mattesr about as much as the word "fucks" sexual connotations - they simply don't relate to its general usage. It's just an insult. One that, generally speaking, is milder on the internet than in real life. It can also be affectionate. Consider "faggot" on the internet to be used the same way australians use "cunt". Both a slur and affectionate, and highly common.

Racial slurs are basically the same as faggot - they're technically insults, they're just very highly used, and therefore lack quite as much "bite" as they would in real life. In particular the word nigger is VERY highly used on the internet, especially on 8chan. They can be used as racial slurs, and may well refer to particular races, but they don't always have to - they're widely and generally used. You have to work it out a little from context.
